liner.body_md:
## What listeners single out

- **Built To Last** (2 reviews): The song's lyrics about one bright star and the stars fading by morning tie into the show's Dark Star hints; Garcia remembered most of the words this time; the reviewer has only heard the album version be any good otherwise [10][15]
- **Wharf Rat** (1 review): The reviewer, sitting third row on Jerry's side, was moved to tears of joy by Wharf Rat [17]
- **Turn On Your Lovelight** (1 review): The reviewer calls it a great Lovelight and says it was the first one in six years [20]
- **The Other One** (1 other source): The space segment is included within the track for The Other One [1]

## The recordings

- **gd1989-10-01.142504.schoeps.cmc4.mk2s.mattes.miller.clugston.flac1648** (recommended): audience recording; 21 songs; 154 min [1]
- **gd89-10-01.aud.8963.sbeok.shnf**: audience recording; 18 songs; 141 min; rated 4.4/5 by 5 [6]. Said about its sound: The audience recording sounds a little boxy [15]
- **gd1989-10-01.sbd-set1.field.26989.sbeok.flac16**: soundboard; 9 songs; 51 min; rated 3.5/5 by 2 [8]. Said about its sound: The set-one soundboard runs fast, with tunes transposed up a half-step, giving a slightly chipmunk-like sound; A half-second dropout in Don't Ease Me In was removed and crossfaded using Sound Forge 7.0 [8][12]
- **gd1989-10-01.142347.sbd.miller.flac2496**: soundboard; 18 songs; 157 min; rated 5/5 by 2 [2]

## Around the show

- Brent Mydland cuts Bobby off at one point in the set-one soundboard [14]
- Bait inhaled nitrous constantly through the night, and Taco peaked during El Paso [20]
- A week later Taco fell off a roof and broke both legs, ending his touring [20]
- Only set one circulates in this soundboard source; the uploader asks for the second set to be seeded [8]
- After the Death Don't two nights earlier, the reviewer expected more from this show, which only teased in places [11]
- The band, especially Jerry, was slow to warm up, but after Masterpiece the show is among the year's hottest [15]

## Tapers and lineage

- **gd1989-10-01.142504.schoeps.cmc4.mk2s.mattes.miller.clugston.flac1648**: taped by Ted Mattes; transferred by Scott Clugston and Charlie Miller; source: flac16/48kHz ; Source Info: Ted Mattes' Master Audience Dat; Schoeps CMC4/MK2S mics spaced on stands, OTS > Aerco preamp > Panasonic SV-250 (16-bit/48k);… [1]. Also: Recorded with Schoeps microphones through CMC4 capsules, per the file name [1]
- **gd89-10-01.aud.8963.sbeok.shnf**: source: AUD>MC>C>CDR [6]
- **gd1989-10-01.sbd-set1.field.26989.sbeok.flac16**: source: Unknown SBD source > ? > CDR [8]. Also: Source was a CDR from Joey Browning; Gary Field extracted, edited and encoded to FLAC in November 2004 [8]
- **gd1989-10-01.142347.sbd.miller.flac2496**: transferred by Charlie Miller; source: UltraMatrix SBD > Cassette Master (TDK MA-XG90) [2]
